Effect script format, executed by SfxScriptStep one step per timer expiry: a byte $00-$0F (except $01) selects the channel in bits 2-3 and is followed by 4 raw APU register bytes (volume/duty, sweep, period low + SfxPitchOffset, period high); $01 m1 m2 ANDs two LFSR values with the masks to randomise pitch and length (SfxRandomize); $10 t waits t ...

phase1.evidence: Static (round 2, lead L-003): bank-6 leader byte at CPU $8000 ($EA) before TableCommonInput at $8001. Same layout as banks 0-5, whose content starts at $8001 after a leader byte. No classified instruction has operand $8000 or a branch to 6:$8000 (round-2 rescan scratch l003.py, 11,895 instructions); the only indirect transfer is the bounded bank-0 JMP ($07F2) sound command dispatch; no RTS/RTI push-dispatch, BRK or RAM execution; vectors $C000/$FFB2/$FFB2; no fetch at 0x18010 in round-1 or r1-a1 traced replays. Competing interpretation: an unreachable NOP prologue falling into $8001 (would also be unreachable); data chosen by layout analogy. Evidence: analysis/leads.json L-003.

regions.summary: Bank-6 leader byte at $8000 (value $EA, the NOP opcode). The bank-6 entry table starts at $8001, like the content of banks 0-5 after their $FF leader. No classified instruction reads, jumps or branches to 6:$8000, so it is treated as data; an unentered NOP prologue is the competing reading (lead L-003).

phase1.evidence: Observed: every instruction in this run had an actual opcode fetch in round-1 traced scenarios (startup, title, taxi intro, cashier, casino floor, $25 slot screen, blackjack table) with this effective PRG context; boundaries from toolkit analysis.decode.

units.name: TableCommonInput
units.summary: Per-frame common table input: B takes back the chips on the table (TakeBackBets), then START opens the cash status screen. Returns carry set if the status screen was shown (caller redraws its table).
